spec.label_definition: Country of origin Greece, Italy, Portugal, Spain
spec.paper: FTIR Spectroscopy and Multivariate Analysis Can Distinguish the Geographic Origin of Extra Virgin Olive Oils.pdf
caveats: Preserve paired spectra of each of 60 oils; 120 spectra are not 120 independent oils.
Use all 570 native fingerprint points; paper bounds 799-1897 are rounded, native first point is 798.892.
No extra SNV or baseline correction; paper says baseline correction not essential.
PLS scores plus Mahalanobis LDA is the implemented paper branch. Alternative GA-8-variable branch is not reproduced and is not replaced with other feature selection.
PLS dimension chosen by Validation accuracy from 1 to 15 (smaller wins ties), not by the paper leave-one-oil-out protocol.
